facts: Historical handbook defined full-time as regularly 37.5 or more hours per week and part-time as under 37.5 hours.

findings.source: email attachment 000249 / June 2021 UHC plan summaries
facts: RTEC website-change correspondence included two UnitedHealthcare Kentucky Choice Plus plan summaries: Base Plan BW3C and Buy Up Plan BW24.

The documents state the formal Certificate of Coverage/Schedule of Benefits controls if the summary conflicts.
findings.currentness: Historical 2021 plan evidence. Strongly proves UHC relationship predates the 2026 'recent implementation' wording.

interpretation_rules: Historical policy and plan attachments can explain older decisions but cannot override current policy.
Blank forms may be safe templates, but completed direct-deposit, medical, workers-comp and application records are restricted.
Vendor training resources are context/resources, not legal or medical authority.
